records.notes: Represents 95.78% of the 2,981 franchised Jackson Hewitt offices active as of April 15, 2024. Excludes 61 offices with no activity during 2024 Tax Season and 65 offices not operated during at least one Tax Season prior to 2024 Tax Season. Company-owned locations excluded. Data unaudited but franchisor aware of no reason to question reliability.

notes: Item 19 discloses Unit Level Revenue (Gross Volume of Business) for three cohorts: Standard Offices, Kiosk Offices, and All Offices combined, all for the fiscal year ended April 30, 2024. No cost, profit, or other financial metrics are disclosed. The 'small_format' cohort_name was used for Standard Offices (stand-alone storefronts) as the closest schema match; Kiosk Offices were mapped to 'other' as no schema value precisely captures kiosk/in-retailer format. Gross Volume of Business is defined similarly to total revenue but excludes taxes, authorized refunds/discounts, and customer bad debt.
